Rationale / required work:
USER approves one bounded source-compatibility correction to allow a separately approved and independently ACCEPTED corrective-readiness v3 artifact to satisfy the predecessor gate for official Case A, followed by one-per-dispatch and independent review for B-E. Earlier failed readiness stays FAILED/ACCEPTED/consumed. Existing successful clean receipt stays tied to original SHA, and risk-qualified continuity cannot be upgraded to exact provenance. Inference inputs exclude frozen truth/scoring material, and original five candidate bytes/order plus ten-dimensional review requirements remain unchanged.

Repository changes must enforce v3-specific, signed exact source/image/procedure/candidate/live authority; authenticated run/artifact digest+inventory and independent review for readiness and each previous case; complete cross-source dispatch history and global single-case consumption; fail-closed unknown/incomplete/ambiguous history; no automatic retry or upstream acceptance promotion. Build an executable proof with deterministic fixtures: synthetic accepted v3 readiness -> Case A eligible; unreviewed/failed/tampered readiness -> Case A blocked; unreviewed/failed A -> Case B blocked; independent ACCEPTED A permits B, serially through E, each once only; old strict v2 unaffected.

Future explicit live/model/cost authority for A-E must be separately bound and must not be inferred from this repository approval or the corrective readiness-specific authority. Prefer one separately scoped cost authorization for the sequential A-E campaign with independent per-case review gates rather than redundant per-case reauthorization, unless the existing frozen contract requires stricter authority. This design choice does not authorize any live action now.

Final source should be frozen only after this repository-only implementation independently accepted and USER merged, before any newly published image, backend rollout or corrective readiness dispatch.
